item.title: JEE AI: Confidence for Conquerors
item.summary: I was once a JEE aspirant. My teachers predicted a rank under 100 in both Mains and Advanced. Instead, I scored only 90%ile. That collapse destroyed my energy, fed anger, and left me defeated. But out of that failure came something new — a force I call Dark Energy. It transformed my frustration into a mission: to take every student’s hand and drop them into their dream college at any cost. That mission became JEE AI — a project crafted with dedication, like weaving wool by hand. Every feature exists to solve the exact problems aspirants face: Core Features of JEE AI My Standings Students set their status and standing. Creates urgency to post daily, challenge peers, and break boredom. Nemesis Protocol AI tracks performance 24/7. Wrongly solved questions are never repeated. Instead, fresh problems on the same concept appear eliminating stagnation. Concept Fusion For JEE Advanced aspirants. AI detects multi‑concept questions (up to 5 linked concepts). Highlights the most important, high‑value problems. Vision Link Just point your phone at a derivation problem. No photo needed — AI solves it live, explaining the approach. Zenith Lounge & Focus Forge Motivation + discipline builder. Foc
